app.name: Dead man's switch
app.tagline: A letter that opens only if you stop checking in.
app.network.mainnet_disabled: Mainnet opens when CRT's service network does. Everything here runs on testnet with test CKB.
app.chain_time_note: Dates follow the chain's clock, which can differ from yours by a few minutes.
wallet.faucet: Get test CKB from the faucet
wallet.needed: Creating, checking in and cancelling are signed with your wallet. Nothing else is.
wallet.sign_prompt: Sign in your wallet to continue.
wallet.insufficient: This needs about {amount} CKB. Your wallet holds {balance} CKB.
letter.title: Your letters
letter.memory_note: The letters stay in this browser tab until you have saved the vaults. Reloading the page before that loses them.
letter.text_placeholder: Write what they should read if you are no longer there to say it.
letter.markdown_hint: Plain text, or simple formatting: headings, lists, links.
letter.files_drop: Drop files here or choose them
letter.files_total: {count, plural, =0 {No files} one {1 file} other {# files}}, {size} in total
letter.files_limit: The vault can hold up to {max}. Remove {excess} to continue.
letter.sender_label: Your name, as the recipients should see it
rhythm.title: How often will you check in?
rhythm.consequence: If you have not checked in by {deadline}, the letters open on {opens}.
rhythm.grace_note: The 24 hours after the deadline are a fixed grace period, not a reminder.
rhythm.long_warning: Terms over 5 years are not offered: the keys use today's cryptography, and short rhythms keep your letter under your control.
guardians.title: Who holds the keys?
guardians.intro: Independent operators of CKB nodes each keep one piece of the key. Any {t} of {n} pieces open the letter after the deadline; fewer than {t} can do nothing, before or after.
guardians.concentration: Your choice: {operators} operators, {networks} networks, {countries} countries. The largest group holds {share}% of the pieces.
guardians.mandatory_title: Guardians that must always take part
guardians.mandatory_intro: Your own node, for example. Without every mandatory guardian the letter can never open, whatever the others do.
guardians.mandatory_trade: Every mandatory guardian makes the letter harder to steal and easier to lose, one for one.
guardians.ack_prompt: A single mandatory guardian on a long term means one failure loses the letter forever. Type “{phrase}” to continue.
guardians.own_node: Run your own node and add it here
guardians.limits: What this cannot protect against: {t} of your guardians agreeing to open early, or a guardian who copies its piece on the first day. Choose them from different places.
price.title: What it costs
price.organiser_note: The service fee goes to the operator of this app. The messenger is included.
price.cancel_free: Cancelling is free and returns the parked CKB.
create.title: Creating the switch
create.step.sign: Sign the creation in your wallet
create.step.wait: Waiting for the guardians ({done} of {n} ready)
create.step.verify: Verifying the guardians against the chain
create.step.arm: Sign the anchoring in your wallet
create.waiting_note: Guardians usually answer within minutes. You can leave this tab open.
create.verify_failed: Verification failed (rule {rule}). The switch was not armed. Nothing can override this check; cancel and start again.
create.done: The switch is live. Now seal the letters.
seal.title: Seal the letters
seal.intro: Each letter is encrypted in your browser and packed, with everything needed to open it later, into one file per recipient: their vault.
seal.saved_checkbox: I have saved the vaults and I understand that only these files can open the letters.
seal.secret_note: Each vault is a secret. Anyone who has one can read its letter after the deadline; nobody can before.
seal.calendar: Add the deadline to your calendar
handover.title: Give each recipient their vault now
handover.p1: Put each file where its recipient can reach it, today: a shared folder in your cloud, a link, a USB stick. It is useless to them until the deadline has passed without you checking in.
handover.p2: Keep a copy yourself, somewhere they could also find it: a USB stick, a shared drive, a notary.
handover.p3: If you change the guardians later, new vaults replace these ones. Hand them over again.
mine.title: My switches
mine.empty: No switches on this device. Create one, or add one by its identifier.
mine.opens_in: Opens in {duration} unless you check in
mine.headroom_sentence: {count, plural, =0 {No guardian may fail: the letters are at risk.} one {1 guardian may fail before the letters are lost.} other {# guardians may fail before the letters are lost.}}
mine.mandatory_headroom: {count, plural, =0 {A mandatory guardian is missing: the letter can no longer open.} one {Mandatory guardians: 1 spare.} other {Mandatory guardians: # spare.}}
mine.checkin_note: Moves the deadline to {deadline}. One signature.
mine.checkin_overlap: Checking in now overlaps {days} days of the current term; that part of the tips is paid twice.
mine.change_warning: Changing guardians produces new vaults. Every recipient must receive theirs; the old vaults stop working.
mine.download_unavailable: The vaults cannot be rebuilt without the letters, which only existed in the tab where you wrote them. Open your owner archive if you kept one.
cancel.title: Cancel this switch?
cancel.consequence: The letters can never be opened. The vaults become useless. The parked CKB comes back to your wallet.
cancel.done: Cancelled. The guardians' key pieces are being deleted.
open.title: Open a vault
open.drop: Drop the vault file here, or choose it
open.or_status: Or check the status of a switch by its identifier
open.integrity.mismatch: This vault does not match its record. Do not trust its contents.
open.opens_if: Opens if {sender} has not checked in by {deadline}.
open.status.not_yet: Not yet. The owner checked in; the current deadline is {deadline}.
open.status.released: Released. {count} of {n} guardians have published their piece.
open.status.cancelled: The owner cancelled this switch on {date}. The letter cannot be opened.
open.status.offline: No connection to the chain. You can paste the guardians' released pieces by hand.
open.short: {have} of {need} pieces are available. {missing} more are needed.
open.bad_piece: The piece from guardian {label} is wrong and was ignored.
open.paste_hint: One per line, as published on the chain.
open.error.decrypt: The letter could not be opened with the recovered key. The vault may have been altered.
open.error.version: This vault was made with a newer version of the app.
about.title: How it works
about.site: Read the full explanation on the website
error.rpc: The chain could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.rejected: You declined the signature in your wallet.
ics.description: Check in at {url} before {deadline}, or the letter opens.
heartbeat.title: How often do the guardians check?
heartbeat.tradeoff: A guardian that disappears is noticed within {delay}. Checking more often costs more.
heartbeat.tip_note: Guardians earn this each time they check. Below their minimum they will not take your letter.
price.monthly: {amount} CKB per month while the switch runs
price.spent_term: Paid to the guardians over {months} months
price.assumptions_text: Based on a block every {seconds} seconds, {runs} checks per guardian over the term, and the cell sizes of the current deployment. Tips are prepaid and paid out check by check; what is not used comes back if you cancel early.
price.detection: A missing guardian is noticed within {delay}.
recipients.title: Who receives a letter?
recipients.intro: Up to {max} people. Each gets their own vault, with only the letter meant for them.
recipients.language_label: Language of their vault and emails
recipients.tell_now: Tell them now that a letter exists (they confirm their address)
letters.mode_shared_note: One letter for everyone, plus a personal note each
handover.link_note: The link is encrypted in your browser and given only to the messenger. Nobody can read it before release.
handover.where_label: Where will you put this vault?
handover.open_link_note: A link anyone can open is safe until release. After release, whoever has the link can read the letter, so a link limited to the recipient's account is better.
owner_code.title: Your owner code
owner_code.note: It lets you change the messenger settings from any device. Keep it like a password; it cannot open the letters.
messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.intro: The messenger reminds you before each deadline and, if the letters open, emails each recipient the link to their vault. It never sees a letter.
drill.title: Try a fire drill
drill.intro: A short rehearsal with real guardians on testnet, for you and your recipients. Nothing real is at stake.
drill.opens_between: The letters open between {earliest} and {latest}: 24 hours of grace after the deadline, plus the guardians' next check.
checkin.title: Check in
checkin.not_owner: This wallet is not the owner of this switch. Connect the wallet you used to create it.
checkin.done: Thank you. The new deadline is {deadline}.
away.title: Away until…
away.intro: Move the deadline to a date of your choice instead of the usual rhythm.
archive.title: Owner archive (optional)
archive.warning: Anyone with this file and the passphrase can read your letters before the deadline.
paper.title: Paper backup
paper.heading: A sealed letter from {sender} for {recipient}
open.practice: Practice vault — nothing here is real.
open.practice_link: See what opening a vault looks like
privacy.title: Privacy
